# sentry_organization_auth_token (Resource)

Sentry Organization Auth Token. Creates an org auth token, for tools such as CI pipelines that upload source maps or create releases. Sentry has no public endpoint to update a token, so changing any argument revokes the token and creates a new one. Sentry records every new token in the audit log and emails the organization owners about it. The token value is only returned when the token is created. It is stored in the Terraform state, so treat the state as sensitive. It can't be recovered on import, so `token` is null after an import.

~> Sentry only lets a signed-in session, or an OAuth application token with the `org:tokens` scope, manage org auth tokens. Personal auth tokens, internal integration tokens and org auth tokens get `403 Forbidden`. The OAuth token also needs `org:read` and `org:ci` to create a token, because it can only grant scopes it holds itself, and `org:write` to revoke one. One way to get such a token is the [Sentry CLI](https://cli.sentry.dev/): run `sentry auth login --scope org:read,org:write,org:ci,org:tokens`, adding any other scopes the rest of your configuration needs, and pass the output of `sentry auth token` to the provider, for example as `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sentry_organization_auth_token" "ci" {
  organization = "my-organization"
  name         = "GitHub Actions"
}

resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "sentry_auth_token" {
  name = "ci/sentry-auth-token"
}

resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "sentry_auth_token" {
  secret_id        = aws_secretsmanager_secret.sentry_auth_token.id
  secret_string_wo = sentry_organization_auth_token.ci.token
  # Pushes the new value whenever the token is replaced.
  secret_string_wo_version = tonumber(sentry_organization_auth_token.ci.id)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the token, up to 255 characters. Renaming the token in Sentry also shows up as a change here, and applying it replaces the token.
- `organization` (String) The slug of the organization the token belongs to.

### Optional

- `scopes` (Set of String) The scopes to grant the token. Sentry currently only allows `org:ci`, which is also the default.

### Read-Only

- `date_created` (String) When the token was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token. Only set when Terraform creates the token; null after an import.
- `token_last_characters` (String) The last four characters of the token, as shown in the Sentry UI.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The token value can't be recovered, so `token` is null after an import.
terraform import sentry_organization_auth_token.ci org-slug/token-id
```
